# blob id

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:blobId`](gmeow-blobId.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/blobId>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The opaque JMAP (RFC 8620) blob identifier for an object. In JMAP this identifies the raw bytes of an Email or of an individual [`BodyPart`](../classes/gmeow-BodyPart.md); the value is provider-scoped and should not be treated as a global identifier.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; `?` -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:blobId`](gmeow-blobId.md) from `?` to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Scope notes

- Typically asserted on an [`EmailMessage`](../classes/gmeow-EmailMessage.md) or [`BodyPart`](../classes/gmeow-BodyPart.md). When byte-exact identity matters, also record [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md).
